name: Fancy Footwork (Combat)
body:
When you strike a foe, you can create an opening to move into a better position.

Prerequisites: Fleet, base attack bonus +3

Benefit(s): You may use a standard action to make a single melee attack against an enemy creature at your highest base attack bonus. If the attack hits, you may move up to 15 feet as a free action as long as you end your movement in a square that would be considered a flanking position in relation to your original square. If the attack was a critical hit, you may then make an attack against the same creature as a swift action from your new square. If you do, the attack gains all the bonuses normally associated with flanking.
